prompt: Which of these heterocycles is aromatic?

options.label: Pyrrole only (the N lone pair goes into the aromatic ring)
Both pyrrole and furan are aromatic

explanation: Pyrrole: N lone pair goes into the ring (p-orbital) to complete 6 π e⁻. Furan: one O lone pair goes in; the other stays in-plane (sp²). Both are aromatic. Pyridine is also aromatic (N lone pair in-plane, N contributes 1 π e⁻ from the double bond). Pyrrolidine (saturated) is NOT aromatic.
